decisions.classicStateMachine: Retain the shared audited canonical guest JavaScript implementation. This measurement does not justify a C++ stream state-machine port.
decisions.nativeModuleResolution: Select the registered native builtin when its finite compiled manifest is admitted; preserve its import and avoid bundling a duplicate canonical/stock factory.
decisions.optionalInstallation: Keep classic installation OFF when it is unused, including when intentionally using the bundled fallback.
decisions.nativeBytePrimitives: Retain separately validated native byte/web primitives where their own semantic and cost evidence justifies them; this comparison does not isolate their cost.
decisions.memoryConclusion: No general or guest-heap memory advantage established. Prepare a separate RSS/startup cohort that excludes large proof reports from workers.
decisions.performanceAdvertising: Report scoped observed medians and artifact sizes only; no statistical significance, universal speedup or production-engine performance transfer.

observations.largeControlNote: About3.40seconds copy/construction/consume control, same scale as large pipelines; no subtraction or isolated bookkeeping cost.

evidenceScope.measurementEngineKind: Diagnostic benchmark ON/OFF pair, not the production engines
evidenceScope.workloads: Four common byte pipelines and three raw control families; no full Streams/Node/ALS/reset/reuse coverage.
evidenceScope.timedCallValidationScope: Authenticated worker exact() guards and successful terminals; independent raw per-batch checksum decoding unavailable.
